strings.zh: 扁平、鱗屑、淡紅或棕紅、不規則邊界、好發遮陽部位(臀部、大腿內側、軀幹)、可癢可不癢
strings.en: Flat, scaly, pink-to-brown patches, irregular borders, predilection for sun-protected sites (buttocks, inner thighs, trunk); pruritus variable

strings.zh: 慢性濕疹、副银屑癬、體癬、藥疹、白斑(色素脫失型)
strings.en: Chronic eczema, parapsoriasis, tinea corporis, drug eruption, vitiligo (hypopigmented variant)

strings.zh: 明顯隆起、紅褐色、可有萎縮 / 皺紋紙感、邊界較清楚
strings.en: Distinctly elevated, red-brown, possible atrophy / cigarette-paper texture, more defined borders

strings.zh: 乾癬、扁平苔癬、慢性濕疹、皮膚澱粉沉著
strings.en: Psoriasis, lichen planus, chronic eczema, cutaneous amyloidosis

strings.zh: 結節、潰瘍、臉部「獅面」(leonine facies)變化
strings.en: Nodules, ulceration, leonine facies on the face

strings.zh: 蜂窩性組織炎、皮膚癌、淋巴瘤其他類型
strings.en: Cellulitis, cutaneous malignancies, other lymphoma types

strings.zh: 異膚紅皮症、藥疹、Sézary、副腫瘤
strings.en: AD-related erythroderma, drug eruption, Sézary, paraneoplastic erythroderma

strings.zh: T1 = patches/plaques < 10% BSA;T2 = ≥ 10%;T3 = 結節 ≥ 1 cm;T4 = 紅皮症 ≥ 80%
strings.en: T1 = patches/plaques < 10% BSA; T2 = ≥ 10%; T3 = tumor ≥ 1 cm; T4 = erythroderma ≥ 80%

strings.zh: N0 = 無腫大;N1-3 依組織學 / 分子陽性程度
strings.en: N0 = no palpable nodes; N1–3 graded by histologic/molecular involvement

strings.zh: M0 = 無;M1 = 有(肝、脾、肺、骨等)
strings.en: M0 = no visceral involvement; M1 = present (liver, spleen, lung, bone, etc.)

strings.zh: 每日 2 次,4-6 週評估;局部反應良好
strings.en: Twice daily, evaluate at 4–6 weeks; local response generally good

strings.en: Apply thinly once daily; contact dermatitis is common

每週 2-3 次;反應率 70-90%;維持治療常需要
strings.en: 2–3 times/week; response rate 70–90%; maintenance often required

strings.zh: 滲透深;長期累積劑量需注意皮膚癌風險

strings.zh: 單次 8-12 Gy 即可達成緩解
strings.en: Single 8–12 Gy dose can achieve remission

低劑量(12 Gy)亦有效;副作用包含暫時性脫毛、汗腺受損
strings.en: Low-dose (12 Gy) is effective; side effects include transient alopecia, sweat-gland impairment

strings.zh: 反應率 ~45%;副作用甲狀腺低下、高血脂(需合併 levothyroxine + statin)
strings.en: Response ~45%; AEs include hypothyroidism, hyperlipidemia (often requires concomitant levothyroxine + statin)
